name: Zhang Zhixia
affiliation: Peking University · Incoming Ph.D. Student · Fall 2027
intro: I am an undergraduate student in Computer Science and Technology at Beihang University. In Fall 2027, I will join the Discovery Intelligence Group (DIG) at Peking University as a direct-entry Ph.D. student, advised by Prof. Ling Yang.
research: My research interests lie in reinforcement learning, large language models, and AI agents. I study how agents learn from interaction and experience to improve reasoning and decision-making. My recent work explores learning signals, credit assignment, and agent collaboration for complex reasoning tasks.
vision: My long-term goal is to build agent systems that autonomously evolve and reliably carry out long-horizon tasks. I am interested in how agents reuse past experience, adapt to new challenges, and turn these capabilities into practical solutions for real-world problems.
